subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Vision Thing
description: A quick win: understand The Vision Thing.

hook.text: A janitor at NASA told JFK he was 'helping put a man on the moon.' That's the power of shared vision.

buildup.text: Without a clear vision, teams optimize locally. Each person does their job but nobody sees the bigger picture.

discovery.text: A good vision is specific enough to guide decisions but broad enough to inspire. 'Organize the world's information'.

twist.text: The leader doesn't need to invent the vision alone. Co-creating it with the team builds ownership and commitment.

climax.text: Repeat the vision until you're bored of hearing yourself say it. Your team only internalized it when they repeat it.

punchline.text: Say it until they say it back. Vision needs repetition.

quiz.question: When has a team truly internalized a vision?
options: When they can recite the mission statement
When team members repeat and reference it in their own decisions
When it's posted on the company website
